reading.body:
Twelve projects make up this collection with a combined 543,768 GitHub stars, led by ollama at 179,921 and llama.cpp at 126,682, together accounting for more than half the category's total stars.

vLLM follows at 90,704 stars, and the remaining projects, sglang, llamafile, mlc-llm, and onnxruntime, range from 21,708 to 33,060 stars each. Licensing splits almost evenly between MIT, covering 5 of the 12 projects, and Apache-2.0, also covering 5, with the remaining 2 under custom licences, a more even split than the small language models category elsewhere in this collection, where Apache-2.0 alone covers more than half of all tracked models.

ollama's own description names support for Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, and Qwen among the models it can run locally, and llama.cpp, described simply as LLM inference in C and C++, is the second most starred project in this category despite predating several of the higher-level tools built on top of it, including llamafile, which is built to distribute and run models as a single file.
